title: BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast reactor with closed fuel cycle

research.what: A lead-cooled fast reactor with on-site mixed nitride uranium-plutonium fuel fabrication and reprocessing, developed by NIKIET under Rosatom's Proryv (Breakthrough) project. Origin: NIKIET BREST fast-reactor design (1990s) and Rosatom's 'Proryv' project (c. 2011); year approximate.

change.what: Rosatom has said physical start-up is planned for 2026-2027, with grid connection stated as the first half of 2027 in earlier statements and 2028 in a later one, at the Siberian Chemical Combine in Seversk.

note: It would be the first Generation IV reactor energy complex with a closed fuel cycle; the schedule has repeatedly moved and sanctions are cited as a difficulty.

title: West-to-East pure hydrogen pipeline (Ulanqab to Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei)

research.what: Transporting pure hydrogen over long distances by dedicated steel pipeline, building on short industrial hydrogen pipelines in China. Origin: Sinopec's earlier short pure-hydrogen industrial pipelines (for example Jiyuan–Luoyang, 2015). This origin is from general knowledge and is not confirmed in the cited pages.

change.what: Sinopec's roughly 1,145 km Ulanqab to Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei pipeline demonstration is planned to be built and put into operation in December 2027, starting at 100,000 tonnes of hydrogen a year.

note: It would be China's first long-distance, cross-provincial pure-hydrogen pipeline, linking green hydrogen from Inner Mongolia to refineries in the east.

refs.label: Solarbe: three pure-hydrogen pipelines to start construction (Chinese)
Sohu: 2025 hydrogen pipeline progress, safety review passed (Chinese)

security.note: It adds a networked, remotely monitored pipeline with SCADA and control systems, which become an operational technology target.

title: On-device AI detection of fake voices in calls (LG U+ ixi-O)

research.what: Anti-spoofing models that tell synthetic or altered voices from real ones, shrunk enough to run on a phone, so the call audio never leaves the device. Origin: LG Uplus in-house Anti-DeepVoice work with LG AI Research (voice activity detection, speech-to-text and anti-spoofing, trained on about 3,000 hours of call data), first shown at MWC in March 2025

change.what: LG Uplus released Anti-DeepVoice in its ixi-O AI call app on 30 June 2025. It flags forged voices within about 5 seconds, and the company says it is the first on-device commercial release of the technology.

note: It moves defence against AI voice-cloning phone fraud onto the handset, so no call data has to be uploaded to a server.

중앙이코노미뉴스: LG유플러스, 온디바이스 AI 기반 '안티딥보이스' 세계 최초 상용화

title: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) for 6G coverage

research.what: Programmable metasurfaces that steer radio waves passively or semi-actively to extend and shape wireless coverage. They grew out of Chinese information-metamaterial research and theoretical RIS work from 2014 onward. Origin: Southeast University information-metamaterials team (Cui Tiejun) with China Mobile, whose 2021 Nanjing field trial of a tunable RIS followed the 2020 IMT-2030 (6G) Promotion Group RIS task force.

change.what: RIS is a listed key 6G technology within China's IMT-2030 programme, which is in its second trial stage (2026–2027). The first commercial 6G systems are expected around 2030, which is when RIS is expected to see real network use, with scaled deployment around 2035.

note: RIS is on China's 6G standardisation and trial roadmap. It is a coverage-enhancement component, not the whole of 6G.

refs.label: Sanpijiang report: 6G definition, key technologies, timeline (RIS, 2030 commercial launch)
2026 Global 6G Technology and Industry Ecosystem Conference: RIS standardisation and industrialisation
Sina Tech: China Mobile and Cui Tiejun's team complete RIS trial

security.note: Programmable surfaces in the radio path add a new controllable element that attackers could misconfigure or spoof, so they need authenticated control channels.

title: Proba-3: artificial solar eclipse by formation flying

research.what: Two ESA spacecraft flying in precise formation about 150 m apart so that one blocks the Sun for the other, forming a space-based coronagraph. Origin: ESA Proba-3 precision formation-flying mission with the ASPIICS coronagraph (Centre Spatial de Liège); described as a planned mission in a 2017 literature review

change.what: In June 2025 ESA released the first images of the solar corona taken during an artificial total eclipse created autonomously in orbit.

note: First demonstration of autonomous millimetre-class formation flying used to make an on-demand eclipse for science, with a hold time of up to 6 hours per orbit.

refs.label: ESA France – Première éclipse solaire artificielle de Proba-3
RTBF – Proba-3 : une première éclipse artificielle pour observer la couronne du soleil

security.note: Autonomous formation control without ground intervention adds a software-dependent spacecraft control chain that would need protecting against tampering.

title: Room-temperature artificial red blood cells (Nara)

research.what: Nara Medical University developed a stockpilable artificial red-cell product that wraps haemoglobin in an artificial membrane, stays stable at room temperature for about two years and needs no blood-type matching. Origin: Nara Medical University (Prof. Hiromi Sakai) research group, supported by AMED from around 2015

change.what: Nara Medical University and partners aim for practical use and insurance coverage around 2030, after investigator-led trials that started in 2025.

note: It could give emergency, remote-island and disaster medicine a blood substitute that does not depend on donations.

refs.label: Nikkei: Nara Medical University to run artificial red-cell trial, practical use around 2030
JST Science Portal: artificial red-cell product trials, target insurance coverage 2030

title: Fully autonomous wind-blade inspection and repair robots (LEBO)

research.what: A Japanese startup built blade-crawling inspection and repair robots, paired with AI analysis of camera and drone images, to plan maintenance for each wind turbine. Origin: LEBO ROBOTICS Inc., a Japanese startup founded in 2018, which developed its own wind-turbine maintenance robots

change.what: Repair robots now run by a ground operator by remote control are expected to become fully autonomous within a few years of the August 2025 article, so around 2027-2028.

note: It would move wind-blade maintenance from remote-controlled robots to AI-planned work that runs without an operator.

refs.label: JapanGov (Kizuna): Robots and AI Take Wind Turbine Maintenance Tech to New Heights
Oxmaint: Best Wind Turbine Maintenance Robots for Reducing Downtime in 2026

security.note: Autonomous robots with remote links and AI image analysis add connected devices and data feeds that attackers could target.

title: AI Digital Convergence Platform for a fusion pilot plant

research.what: The Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory is building a fusion foundation model, a digital twin of the NSTX-U experiment and an AI computing infrastructure called STELLAR-AI to speed fusion pilot-plant development. Origin: Genesis Mission fusion work at PPPL (2025): NSTX-U digital twin, a fusion foundation model and STELLAR-AI

change.what: The DOE's Genesis Mission frameworks report ties AI-guided fusion engineering to a national milestone of an operational US fusion pilot plant on the grid between 2030 and 2035.

note: It treats whole-facility AI design and simulation as a way to shorten the fusion innovation cycle, which is separate from AI plasma control; 2030 is the start of the stated pilot-plant window.

refs.label: US DOE Office of Science: Genesis Mission Frameworks
POWER magazine: DOE details 26 Genesis Mission AI challenges
PPPL: Genesis Mission launch

security.note: A shared national AI platform that connects facilities and sensitive experimental data concentrates the data and models an attacker would target.

title: Envision Galileo AI turbine with Tianji/Tianshu models

research.what: Envision built an energy-specific weather foundation model and a wind, solar, storage and power-market energy model, and fed live turbine data back into the weather model to improve forecasts. Origin: Envision Energy's in-house AI forecasting programme, which ranked first in China Southern Grid's power and load forecasting contests in 2022–2024.

change.what: In October 2025 Envision launched the Galileo AI wind turbine, which runs on its Tianji weather model and Tianshu energy model, after a demonstration wind farm had fitted the Tianshu control module to half its turbines since 2024.

note: It is a field-tested case of AI foundation models used for energy-asset design, control and forecasting. The company reports a revenue gain of about 20.9% against unmodified turbines at the same farm.

refs.label: People's Daily (China Energy News): 以AI重构风电价值链引领行业确定性增长

security.note: AI models that control turbines and take live data feedback from them add cloud-connected control paths that attackers could target.

title: Kepler: first commercial optical data relay constellation

research.what: Kepler shifted to laser-based optical data relay, validating space-to-space, space-to-ground and space-to-air laser links and aligning with Space Development Agency optical standards. Origin: Kepler Communications optical relay programme and SDA-compatible optical inter-satellite link demonstrations (strategy shift announced 2024)

change.what: Kepler launched the first ten satellites of its optical relay network on 11 January 2026, starting the first commercial optical data relay constellation with on-orbit compute and hosted payloads.

note: It moves laser inter-satellite relay from demonstrations to a commercial network, with service due in 2026.

refs.label: Kepler: first tranche of optical relay satellites launched
DCD: Kepler plans January launch of optical satellites
SpaceQ: Kepler to launch 10 optical data relay satellites

security.note: Hosted compute and laser links between space, air and ground add new nodes and interfaces that attackers could target.

title: Computer passwords (MIT CTSS)

research.what: MIT's time-sharing project needed a way to give each user private files on a shared computer, so it gave each user a login and password. Origin: Compatible Time-Sharing System (CTSS) at the MIT Computation Center, led by Fernando Corbató, first demonstrated November 1961; described in Corbató et al., 'An Experimental Time-Sharing System' (1962)

change.what: CTSS is credited as the first computer system to use password login, and it ran for multiple users at MIT and at remote sites.

note: The per-user password became the basic way computers check who is using them, and the first password-file leak (1962) was an early security incident.

title: Glass-core packaging substrates in volume production

research.what: Intel showed glass-core substrates as a replacement for the organic material in advanced chip packages, with tuneable thermal expansion and better flatness for large AI packages. Origin: Intel glass core substrate research announcement, September 2023

change.what: Substrate makers including Absolics (SKC) and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have published targets to begin volume production of glass-core substrates in 2027, after BOE qualified a pilot line and sent samples to customers in September 2026.

note: Glass cores could get past the warpage and size limits of organic substrates that now hold back very large AI accelerator packages, but mass-production dates have slipped several times.

refs.label: VLSI.kr: The Glass-Core Substrate Race (Oct 2026)
Tech Times: BOE completes glass core substrate qualification (Sep 2026)
IRZ: Glass chip substrates still have no commercial product (Sep 2026)

security.note: This is a packaging-material change, so it adds no new remote attack surface, though concentrating supply among a few makers creates supply-chain risk.

title: Kubota M5 Narrow tractor autonomy package (with Agtonomy)

research.what: Agtonomy developed retrofit autonomy software that lets existing compact tractors for specialty crops run without a driver, and later worked with Kubota on it. Origin: Agtonomy's autonomy platform for compact tractors in vineyards and orchards (company founded about 2021; the year is not confirmed by the cited sources)

change.what: At CES in January 2026, Kubota began selling an autonomy package for its 105.7 hp M5 Narrow tractor. Treasury Wine Estates was already running four of these tractors in North Napa Valley for mowing and under-vine cultivation.

note: It is the first time a major tractor maker has sold factory autonomy for narrow-row specialty crops such as vineyards and orchards, adding to Deere's driverless tillage on row-crop farms.

refs.label: Meticulous Research – Autonomous Tractors Outlook 2026–2036
Global Brands Magazine – Autonomous Tractors: 16 Cameras and No Driver in 2026

security.note: Connected, software-defined tractors that are supervised remotely give attackers new targets: the fleet-management link and the autonomy software could be tampered with to disrupt farm work or cause unsafe machine movement.

title: Hydraulic fracturing of oil and gas wells

research.what: Floyd Farris of Stanolind Oil and Gas studied how treatment pressure affects well output. This led to the experimental 'Hydrafrac' treatment of the Klepper No. 1 well in the Hugoton gas field, Kansas. Origin: Stanolind Oil and Gas Klepper Gas Unit No. 1 test, Hugoton field, Grant County, Kansas, 1947; described by J. B. Clark (Stanolind) in a 1948 paper; patent 1949

change.what: Halliburton held an exclusive licence and carried out the first two commercial fracturing treatments on 17 March 1949, in Stephens County, Oklahoma and Archer County, Texas. It treated 332 wells in the first year.

note: Fracturing became a core well-stimulation method for oil and gas. Combined later with horizontal drilling, it made the shale gas and tight oil revolution possible.

refs.label: AAPG Explorer: Digging the Roots of Hydraulic Fracturing
Engineering and Technology History Wiki: Hydraulic Fracturing
Wikipedia: Fracking in the United States
GeoExpro: A Short History of Hydraulic Fracturing

security.note: The original mechanical process adds no cyber exposure. Modern frac fleets rely on networked pumping controls, but that came much later.

title: ELIZA: first chatbot (MIT DOCTOR script)

research.what: Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT built a program that held typed conversations in natural language by spotting keywords and turning a user's sentences back into scripted replies. Origin: Weizenbaum's ELIZA work at MIT, 1964–66, published as 'ELIZA: A Computer Program for the Study of Natural Language Communication Between Man and Machine', Communications of the ACM, 1966

change.what: ELIZA, running the DOCTOR psychotherapist script, was used interactively by people at MIT through typewriter terminals, and copies spread to other universities. It was the first conversational program that people actually used.

note: It created the chatbot genre and the 'ELIZA effect', where users treat a program as if it understands them. Both ideas still shape conversational AI and the debate about it.

refs.label: Britannica: Eliza
History.com: Why a 1960s chatbot left its creator deeply unsettled
From Eliza to XiaoIce (Microsoft Research, arXiv)

security.note: ELIZA showed early how easily users trust a machine that seems to converse, which is the same social-engineering risk that modern chatbots raise.
